description: Look up a TuneViva score by its numeric ID. Returns title, score_url (the tuneviva.com score page), musicxml (a compressed MusicXML (MXL) download), url (the tuneviva.com practice page for the score) and a message about the files. If the score is not found or has no MusicXML, only message is returned.

id.description: Numeric score ID from a TuneViva score URL

name: get_practice_score

message.description: Note about the returned files, or a not-found message when the score is unavailable

musicxml.description: Download URL of the score as compressed MusicXML (MXL); absent when the score is not found

score_url.description: TuneViva score page with notation preview and details; absent when the score is not found

title.description: Score title; absent when the score is not found

url.description: TuneViva practice page that opens this score in the browser; absent when the score is not found

title: Get practice score
